name: EComm copy

chatHistory.content:
Heyo, i need a b-roll style animation for this transcript. make sure to follow the timestamps from the transcript closley, DO NOT OFFSET AT ALL. Make sure to get inspired from the transcript and what is being said, meaning what is being said is being animated on screen. Please FOLLOW THE TIMESTAMPS!
Also, do not make it extremly text heavy, it is gonna be on top of a voice over, so absolutley no need for any texts. For background, use "corner_background_orange"



1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:01,880
One of your 48 locations has been

2
00:00:01,881 --> 00:00:03,200
bleeding orders for three weeks.

(a map, 48 green pins, one turns bigger and red)

3
00:00:03,760 --> 00:00:05,600
Brand level reports won't catch it,

(report mockup, X over it)

4
00:00:05,601 --> 00:00:06,720
and the delivery platform

5
00:00:06,721 --> 00:00:08,400
dashboards won't either.

(delivery platform dashboard mockup, X over it)

6
00:00:08,401 --> 00:00:10,840
An Apify Zapier and Power BI

7
00:00:10,841 --> 00:00:12,960
pipeline will in about 15 minutes.

(Apify, Zapier, Power BI logos showing up with “+” in between - when 15 minutes gets mentioned, a clock shows up signaling 15 minutes - aka “apify + zapier + power bi = 15 minutes)

8
00:00:12,961 --> 00:00:14,600
Most competitive monitoring still

9
00:00:14,601 --> 00:00:15,760
needs someone to manually pull

10
00:00:15,761 --> 00:00:18,000
listings location by location,

(dashboard mockup, each location (like 10) pulling listing one by one into a section)

11
00:00:18,001 --> 00:00:19,240
and even then you're only

12
00:00:19,241 --> 00:00:21,600
seeing one zip code on one day.

(a calendar showing only 1 week - each day has a different random NY zip code)

13
00:00:21,601 --> 00:00:23,360
A system that runs itself doesn't.

(automation system mockup with relevant stuff)

14
00:00:24,000 --> 00:00:25,880
What we're building today refreshes

15
00:00:25,881 --> 00:00:27,120
every location's competitive

16
00:00:27,121 --> 00:00:29,200
position weekly, surfaces the ones

17
00:00:29,201 --> 00:00:30,840
that need attention, and stays out

18
00:00:30,841 --> 00:00:32,479
of your way the rest of the time.

(i dont know what to show here, use your creative juices for the last part)
